```{r}
# Build one ggplot per city &and wrap them into a single image with patchwork.
make_city_maps <- function(data, fill_var, fill_label, ncol = 3) {
  cities <- sort(unique(data$city))
  plots <- lapply(cities, function(cty) {
    ggplot(dplyr::filter(data, city == cty)) +
      geom_sf(aes(fill = .data[[fill_var]]), colour = NA) +
      scale_fill_viridis_c(name = fill_label, na.value = "grey90") +
      labs(title = cty) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        axis.text = element_blank(),
        axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"))})
  patchwork::wrap_plots(plots, ncol = ncol)}
```

# Overview

```{r}
grid_model_all %>%
  sf::st_drop_geometry() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(city) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_cells         = dplyr::n(),
    mean_richness   = mean(sp_richness, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_shannon    = mean(shannon, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_simpson    = mean(simpson, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_records   = sum(n_records, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_survey_days = sum(n_days, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 2, caption = "Summary of diversity and recording effort by city")
```

# Models

```{r}
# Manual likelihood ratio test: works for any models supporting logLik()/df.residual()
lr_test <- function(null_model, full_model) {
  ll_null <- as.numeric(logLik(null_model))
  ll_full <- as.numeric(logLik(full_model))
  df_null <- attr(logLik(null_model), "df")
  df_full <- attr(logLik(full_model), "df")

  stat <- 2 * (ll_full - ll_null)
  df   <- df_full - df_null
  p    <- pchisq(stat, df = df, lower.tail = FALSE)

  tibble::tibble(
    logLik_null = ll_null,
    logLik_full = ll_full,
    AIC_null    = AIC(null_model),
    AIC_full    = AIC(full_model),
    chisq       = stat,
    df          = df,
    p_value     = p)}
```

## Species richness (negative binomial GLM)

```{r}
summary(richness_models$full)$coefficients %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3, caption = "Full richness model coefficients")
```

```{r}
lr_test(richness_models$null, richness_models$full) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3, caption = "Richness: Null vs. Full models")
```

## Simpson diversity (beta regression)

```{r}
summary(simpson_models$full)$coefficients$mean %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3, caption = "Full Simpson model coefficients")
```

```{r}
lr_test(simpson_models$null, simpson_models$full) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3, caption = "Simpson: Null vs. Full Models")
```
